title: Axiom Releases 16M Line AI Formalization of Stacks Project Math Infrastructure
summary:
A new digital library now provides a machine-verified foundation for modern algebraic geometry, converting decades of manual mathematical research into a format accessible to AI. The AI startup Axiom has published the work as an open formalization of the Stacks Project, turning tens of thousands of results into 16M lines of machine-checkable code in the Lean language.

The project aims to demonstrate that AI can generate massive scale software for complex knowledge without losing the structural integrity required for mathematical proof. By preserving the interconnected nature of the original project, Axiom intends to give AI agents a reusable, high-quality base upon which they can build and verify new mathematical theories.
